Let me verify the memory against the Makefile.

Run these from the repo root:

- **`make test-fast`** is the one for day-to-day work. It runs `pytest -m "not postgres" -q`, so it skips the Postgres integration tests and needs no database.
- **`make test`** runs the full suite with `pytest -q`. It includes the tests marked `postgres`, which connect to a real Postgres instance.

A stored project memory says to start the database with `docker compose up db` before `make test`, or the Postgres tests fail on connection errors. I couldn't confirm that here. There's no `docker-compose*.yml` file in the repo, so you may need to set up Postgres another way. I also didn't run the tests.
